title: Definitions for In-Person Appointments Deposit Refunds: Days a Missed Slot Was Held
content:
**Definition.** For the no-show fee the refund offsets on a missed In-Person Appointments visit, the days the missed slot was held for the patient are counted to the scheduled date from the latest move where the patient moved the visit, from the confirmation date where the patient confirmed the visit and never moved it, and from the booking date otherwise.

**Terms used in the definition.**

- *The patient moved the visit*: the appointment record shows a reschedule count of 1 or more patient-requested reschedules.
- *The latest move*: the date of the latest reschedule on the appointment record.
- *The confirmation date*: the date on which the patient confirmed attendance, as shown on the appointment record.
- *The booking date*: the date the booking was made.

**Order of the three starting dates.** The latest move is used whenever the patient moved the visit; the confirmation date only for a visit confirmed and never moved; the booking date only for a visit neither moved nor confirmed.

**Applications (hypothetical, scheduled date 2026-09-30).**

| Booking date | Confirmation date | Latest move | Starting date | Days held |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-02 | none | none | 2026-06-02 | 120 |
| 2026-06-02 | 2026-09-23 | none | 2026-09-23 | 7 |
| 2026-06-02 | 2026-06-10 | 2026-08-01 | 2026-08-01 | 60 |
